requirements.text: The FEC model is assessed against the AI system definition and registered in the AI Inventory, with the reasoning documented where it is concluded not to be an AI system.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Every material SIRA risk is covered by at least one scenario or model in the coverage matrix, or the gap is recorded with a remediation plan approved by Financial Crime Compliance.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Each scenario has a documented objective identifying the typology addressed, the SIRA risk mapped and the customer, product and channel population covered.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: The scenario specification defines logic, parameters, look-back periods, aggregation rules and exclusions precisely enough to allow independent re-implementation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Exclusions from the scenario population are justified and their volume quantified.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: New or changed scenarios are tested on historical data before production, reporting expected alert volumes, share of historical productive cases detected and overlap with existing scenarios.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Customers and accounts are segmented into behaviourally homogeneous groups, distinguishing at least natural persons, small businesses and corporates, with documented statistical support reviewed annually.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Initial thresholds are calibrated per segment on the statistical distribution of the parameter, with the rationale for the selected percentile and the expected alert volume documented.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Threshold settings or adjustments based on expert judgement have a documented risk-based rationale, and no threshold is raised on operational capacity grounds alone.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: ATL testing is performed per scenario at least annually, reporting alert volume, productive share, FIU-report share and disposition quality from a QA sample of closed non-productive alerts.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: BTL testing is performed for each threshold-based scenario at least annually and after any threshold increase, in bands down to at least 20% below the threshold, reviewed blind by trained analysts.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: At least 59 events per BTL band are reviewed, so that zero productive events supports a productive rate below 5% at 95% confidence.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Where BTL testing finds productive events, the threshold is lowered or the decision not to lower it is justified by a documented risk assessment approved by Financial Crime Compliance.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: The ATL and BTL methodology, samples, reviewer decisions and conclusions are documented in a testing report retained with the model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: The feedback-loop bias of analyst-decision labels is assessed, and at least 2% of low-priority alerts are reviewed monthly irrespective of score.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Prioritisation scores determine only the order of alert handling and do not suppress alerts outside an approved auto-closure band.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: An auto-closure band contains no more than 1% of productive alerts in the out-of-time test sample, and at least 50 auto-closed alerts are QA-reviewed monthly.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Discriminatory power of the prioritisation model is measured out-of-time per scenario group, together with the recall of productive alerts per priority band.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: The CRR methodology assesses at least customer, product and service, delivery channel and geographic risk factors, with factor selection and weights justified by the SIRA and legislative risk factors.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal provision authored; AMLR article on individual risk assessment of the customer (Art. 20) to be confirmed.

requirements.text: Mandatory high-risk triggers, including PEPs, links to high-risk third countries and adverse FIU or law-enforcement information, override the calculated score to at least the High class.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: The CRR is back-tested at least annually, showing incidence of FIU reports, integrity exits and confirmed cases increasing monotonically from Low to High class.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: CRR overrides are monitored and the methodology is reviewed where more than 5% of customers in a segment are overridden in a year.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Fraud labels include confirmed fraud from customer claims, chargebacks and investigations, and a documented label maturity window of at least 90 days for card fraud is applied.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to fraud detection models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Fraud model performance is measured at the operating threshold by count detection rate, value detection rate and false-positive ratio per payment channel, against documented targets.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to fraud detection models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: The operating threshold is set through a documented analysis of fraud losses prevented, false-positive customer impact and operational capacity, approved by the model owner and Fraud Risk Management.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to fraud detection models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: The false-positive ratio is monitored weekly, and a breach of target for four consecutive weeks triggers root-cause analysis and, where necessary, recalibration.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to fraud detection models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Where the model supports the transaction-risk-analysis exemption, the documentation shows how real-time risk analysis meets Art. 18 and how fraud rates are calculated under Art. 19 of the PSD2 RTS.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to fraud detection models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8); PSD2 RTS article references checked.

requirements.text: Every transaction monitoring scenario is tuned at least annually and after material changes in products, customers, typologies or data, using ATL and BTL results.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: Data feeds are reconciled monthly against source systems on transaction counts and values, and unexplained differences above 0.1% are investigated and reported.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).

requirements.text: For transaction monitoring, the documentation includes a scenario library giving per scenario the objective, SIRA mapping, specification, segments, thresholds and rationale, exclusions, test results and tuning history.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to anti-money laundering models (transaction monitoring, CRR, screening) only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal standard text authored for the library (FEC-STD-600 v1.8).
